subs: Yet Shani is a most noble deity,
By God's command, he only shows
sorrow to those who do wrong.
He is not the one who gives pain.

caption.title: Don't Blame Shani — It's Your Own Karma 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: At the Lord's wedding feast, the nine planets were serving — and everyone quietly hoped Shani wouldn't be the one to serve their plate! Yet Shani is a most noble deity and a true devotee of Vishnu. By God's command he only shows the results of wrong deeds. He is not the one who gives us pain — our own karma is. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 07" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).

subs: matters deeply for how we live.

caption.title: Not Even a Small Task Succeeds Without Grace 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: When the Lord asks the gods for their consent to His wedding, they reply: "Who are we to give consent? Just being at this festival is our great fortune." The lesson for our own lives: whatever we do, however small the task, we need the Lord's grace. Without it, no work succeeds. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 07" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).

subs: He gave each person a task.
See how wonderfully it was planned.
made sure no one's heart was hurt.
When does an event go well?
and every good soul who came
If no one's heart is hurt,

caption.title: The Real Test of a Good Celebration 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: How do you know a wedding, a festival or any function went well? Not by the decorations or the food. At Srinivasa's wedding, Rudradeva — who knows every mind — made sure no one's heart was hurt. When every guest, priest and good soul who came leaves happy, that is the greatest blessing, and the event was a success. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 07" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).

subs: The gods who preside over us
guiding our senses, mind and body.
They are all our own family.
No one has a family as big as ours!
How could our family be small?
Brahma and all the gods our kin.
Know this, and nothing is lacking.
Whose side did the gods come for?

caption.title: With God as Your Father, What Do You Lack? 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Srinivasa jokes that he has no relatives to bring to his own wedding. But the truth is the opposite: God is our Father, Lakshmi our Mother, and Brahma and all the gods — who guide our senses, mind and body — are our own family. Once we know this, why call ourselves poor or alone? No one has a bigger family. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 07" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).

subs: Though He is the Supreme Lord,
on a great occasion like a wedding,
Don't bathe and just doze off —
He showed this to the whole world.
Praised by Brahma and all the gods,
the Lord still bowed to the elders,

caption.title: Even the Lord Bows to His Elders 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Before His wedding, Srinivasa — the Supreme Lord, praised by Brahma and all the gods — bows to the great sages and elders and seeks their blessings. He doesn't need to. He does it to teach the world: on every great occasion in life, first seek the blessings of your elders. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 07" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).
